blocks.tamil_translation: “Even if a black slave whose ears and nose have been cut off is appointed as amir over you, if he leads you according to the command of Allah Ta'ala, listen to his word and obey him,” Hazrat Umm al-Husain (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا، وَإِنِ اسْتُعْمِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَبْدٌ حَبَشِيٌّ كَأَنَّ رَأْسَهُ زَبِيبَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب السمع والطاعة للامام....، رقم:٧١٤٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Even if an Abyssinian slave, black in colour, with a small head like a dried raisin, is appointed as amir over you! Keep listening to the amir's word and obeying him,” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ وَائِلِ نِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَا حُمِّلُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ مَا حُمِّلْتُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب في طاعة الامراء وان منعوا الحقوق، رقم:٤٧٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Keep listening to the word of the amirs and obeying them, because they will be questioned about their responsibilities (whether they acted honestly), and you will be questioned about your responsibilities (whether you obeyed the amir). So, each one should be occupied in fulfilling his own responsibility, whether others fulfil theirs or not,” Hazrat Wa'il Hadrami (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْعِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:
